variant_desc: 32-double 256B struct (4 cache lines), hot loop reads 2 fields -> split into hot[] (16B/rec, 4 recs/line) + cold[] (variant 2: seed=44, n_scale=1.5x)
novelty_rationale: Tests hot/cold field separation as distinct from AoS->SoA (DS-4): the slow struct is exactly one cache line, so a naive SoA split of every field would not help — what helps is grouping only the actually-accessed fields into a separate dense array. Compilers do not perform cross-program data-layout splitting because they cannot prove no external code reads cold fields.
